title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Software and SaaS Spending - Qualifying Categories
summary: This document explains which software/SaaS purchases qualify for the Business Silver Rewards Card’s 10.0% category rate, listing examples such as productivity SaaS, CRM/ERP/accounting/project management subscriptions, cloud infrastructure/developer tools, cybersecurity/identity management, and marketing automation/analytics/content platforms. It also covers how to ensure qualification: pay the software provider directly or through its official billing portal, verify statement merchant category descriptions for software coding, and if the vendor sells both services and physical goods, only the portion coded as software earns 10.0%.
